name: popover
useFor: Use for a small form or detail tied to one control (rename a site, set a buffer distance) that keeps the page in view. Use PopoverHeader, PopoverTitle and PopoverDescription for its head.
constraints: Long forms or several steps (use Dialog or Sheet)
A popover that opens on hover (use Hover Card)
source: Not in Figma. Drawn in Mireye's grammar: the Bone cut frame of Figma UI · Inputs (442:107)
title: Popover
description: A Bone panel with the 6px cut corner and a 1px Stone line, no shadow, 16px of padding, a 13px medium title over a line in the secondary ink; it grows from its trigger in 150ms.
